system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. «Plasma Field» ignores [Cancel: Shock] status on targets and the strength of the [Barrier] is increased by +[Recovery].

(SR2): Gain +1D to your [Accuracy check] for «Lightning Chamber».

You are a sorcerer who specializes in magic that manipulates electric shocks. Its power, compared to the wrath of God, will be your ally in offense and defense.
